arguments.sql:
SELECT h.id, h.weight_kg, typeof(h.weight_kg) AS weight_type,
       COUNT(hp.hero_id) AS power_links, COUNT(sp.id) AS matched_powers
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
GROUP BY h.id, h.weight_kg
ORDER BY h.id

arguments.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN h.weight_kg IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
            WHEN h.weight_kg = 0 THEN 'zero'
            WHEN h.weight_kg < 0 THEN 'negative'
            ELSE 'positive' END AS weight_category,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN h.height_cm = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_height_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN h.height_cm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_height_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
                         THEN h.superhero_name END) AS george_lucas_heroes
FROM superhero AS h
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
GROUP BY weight_category

FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND h.id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
  )
LIMIT 1
